);

          var keyword = $(".ss_input").val();
          $(document).keypress(function (e){
            if(e.keyCode == 13){
                window.location.href = "/social?k="+keyword+"&c=&p=&d=&PageIndex=1&class=1#zw";
            }
          })
      })
</script>
